event.description: Reduce FF width to 15 with independent head-local output maps
event.proposal: family: feed-forward width; current retained incumbent is 3136 parameters at 99.9500%, a +0.95 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0031, per-head block-diagonal output mixing with ff16 at 3136/99.95%; same-family failed result: attempt-0022, MQA with full output projection and ff16 at 3520/98.50%; prior attempts in this family: 9. Hypothesis: the new independent head-local output organization made ff16 viable, so the nearest one-unit continuation may still preserve enough nonlinear capacity at ff15, yielding 3072 parameters. This is more informative than changing token or position representations because it isolates the remaining FF width boundary while keeping the successful attention organization fixed; the nearest untested alternative is a larger architectural substitution whose effect would be confounded with FF capacity. Keep d16/h2/L2, independent 8x8 head-local maps, MQA, affine-free block pre-norms, final affine norm, learned positions, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3136 parameters.
